newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-SHARKS' NICHOLLS SUSPENDED FOR CROSS-CHECK.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-SHARKS' NICHOLLS SUSPENDED FOR CROSS-CHECK.

text.p: San Jose Sharks centre Bernie Nicholls has been suspended for two games and fined $1,000 as a result of a match penalty for deliberate injury against Florida Panthers defenceman Ed Jovanovski, the NHL said on Friday.
The incident occurred in overtime of the Sharks-Panthers game on February 25.

"Mr Nicholls' crosscheck against Mr Jovanovski was reckless and dangerous," said NHL Senior Vice President and Director of Hockey Operations Brian Burke. "It was clear that his actions were not defensive in nature."
Nicholls will miss Friday's game at Hartford and the March 1 game at Toronto.
Nicholls has 12 goals and 32 assists for 44 points in 61 games for San Jose this season.
